verdict.rationale: Community users report using Notion itself to track tasks and projects, and the docs confirm that pages and databases can be created, so the core idea of creating tasks is plausibly supported. Nothing in the pack documents assigning tasks to teammates or setting due dates. missing for 10: documented task assignment to teammates, documented due-date fields, first-party docs describing a task-management workflow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: We use it to keep track of all of our tasks and projects
We have tried to use it as a wiki, project tracker, issue tracker, CRM & spreadsheet.
